sf.label: Stockfish 19
sf.method: Baseline: unrestricted MultiPV 3 at every position, 10M nodes, last completed iteration. Candidate comparisons (60M nodes) and deep checks (200M nodes) restrict the root moves and keep their own budgets.

notes.text: Black was already worse. 50...g6 lets White use hxg6 and then advance the remaining g-pawn; 50...f4 instead gains active rook counterplay with ...Rh4+. This is a loss of defensive chances from an already unfavorable position.
Stockfish 19, 16 Nov 2026 (1 thread, 200M nodes, depth 32, deep check): f4 −5.06, played g6 −6.64 (mover POV). The catalog alternative is better by 1.58 pawns.
